text:
Maya: Quick sync — ACME+ pilot just pushed back: they want tenant-routing parity plus a predictable volume discount to sign the contract. We need a go/no-go on shipping parity surface vs keeping Q3 to deliver our routing differentiator.
Alex: Clarify parity scope? Is this full routing policies (per-tenant weights, fallbacks) or a narrower shim?
Devon: Sales says ACME+ will churn if we don’t match competitor routing controls. They flagged 'per-tenant region pinning' and 'fallthrough SLA' as blockers.
Maya: From legal/security calls ACME+ also needs audit logs for decisioning. So parity bundle = routing controls + audit trail + documented rollout plan.
Sam: Engineering estimate: parity shim (limited flags + audit events) ~2w dev + 1w QA if we avoid refactor. Full routing rewrite to support weights/regions is 6-8w.
Kelly: What about cost/ops? If we enable per-tenant pinning, we add routing cardinality — will increase routing table size and metric cardinality. Need SRE signoff.
Ava: Can we offer a conditional pilot config: "parity-lite" (flags + logs) for an initial committed deal with strict usage caps and canaryed rollout? ACME+ cares about feature parity language in contract.
Alex: parity-lite technical checklist in prod:
```
- feature flag gating
- audit events to kinesis (schema v1)
- simple fallback to global routing
- canary by tenant id
```
Maya: Launch criteria proposal: 1) parity-lite implemented, 2) canary on 1 tenant + 2 canary customers, 3) latency delta < 15ms p95, 4) audit events validated in staging.
Devon: Sales ask: include a 6-month roadmap commitment to full routing controls in the contract appendix. That buys time.
Kelly: Ops requirement: enable metric sampling on parity-lite to avoid high-cardinality billing surprises. Also, require auto-eviction policy if routing table grows > 20% baseline.
Sam: We can implement sampling + eviction as config flags, low effort. Eviction needs runbook.
Maya: Decision needed by EOD tomorrow: (A) ship parity-lite + contract appendix + price escalator OR (B) delay and push full routing into Q3 but risk losing ACME+. Thoughts?
Alex: Technical leaning: (A) doable with acceptable risk if we keep parity-lite scoped and gated.
Devon: Sales leaning (A) with appendix. They can close ACME+ this week if we sign.
Kelly: Ops supports (A) if sampling/eviction included and SRE runbook created.
Ava: One caveat — marketing needs to not advertise 'parity' broadly; call it 'customer routing pilot' until we ship full controls.
Maya: Okay — action items:
- Alex, Sam: ship parity-lite spike PR and tests by tomorrow noon.
- Kelly: draft SRE runbook + eviction config by EOD.
- Devon/Ava: update term sheet with appendix language and usage caps.
- Maya: I’ll update leadership and approve go-ahead if code + runbook land.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: parity-lite/feature-flag -> staging @ 2026-04-14T18:00Z
Alex: Noted. I’ll open the PR and tag everyone.
Devon: Thanks team — ACME+ is on the hook for a pilot commitment once we sign. :crossed_fingers:
